subject: QuantPath: request for trial runway assistance due to integration delays
messages:
From: Alexei Novak <alexei@quantpath.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantPath POC timeline / sandbox availability

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the platform walkthrough this week. We made good progress on the model plumbing but hit a blocker with our legacy ETL mapping that prevents end-to-end validation against your sandbox endpoints. Our engineering team estimates ~2–3 weeks to resolve (data schema migration + connector tests).

Right now the POC is on the hosted trial and we’re close to exhausting the sandbox quota. Given the integration work, can Redwood provide a 30-day trial extension and a small sandbox credit allowance so we can finish E2E validation and the acceptance demo? Specifically: 30 extra days on the trial window and $1,500 of sandbox credits to run full-volume ingestion/QA.

I attached the integration timeline and a short note from our eng lead outlining the blocker. Procurement will need a note confirming we have a runway before they proceed with a PO.

Appreciate any help to keep the momentum.

—Alexei
Alexei Novak
Head of ML Engineering, QuantPath
alexei@quantpath.com
[Attachment: quantpath_integration_timeline.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)]

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alexei Novak <alexei@quantpath.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantPath POC timeline / sandbox availability

Alexei — thanks for the clear summary and timeline. Sorry to hear about the ETL snag but this is exactly the kind of thing we want to smooth for customers.

Two quick items:
- I can provision a 30-day extension on the trial immediately so your engineers can run the E2E tests.
- For sandbox credits, I’ll need internal approval from Sales Ops/Finance. I’ll request a provisional $1,500 sandbox credit and follow up with confirmation and any required audit note for procurement.

Could you confirm the acceptance-demo target date once the 2–3 week estimate is firm? That helps me justify the credit and align the CS engineer for the demo. Also I’ve attached a HubSpot link to our deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/23456.

I’ll loop in Camila and Ben to coordinate the credits request internally — Camila, can you weigh in on typical approvals for this size of POC top-up? Ben, please keep the CS calendar open around late April as a placeholder.

I’ll reply again once Sales Ops confirms.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0113

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: QuantPath POC timeline / sandbox availability — credit request

Forwarding Sergio’s note — QuantPath (HUB-23456) is asking for 30-day trial extension + $1,500 sandbox credits due to an ETL/integration blocker. Quick summary below for ops:

- Account: QuantPath (early-stage, ML infra team)
- ARR motion: POC -> pilot -> paid (expected if E2E demo succeeds)
- Requested: 30-day extension, $1,500 sandbox credit
- Rationale: engineering delay outside Redwood; procurement needs runway confirmation to sign PO

From a risk/cost perspective this is a small ask for a high-probability conversion. Recommend approving provisional credit contingent on: (1) we log the credit as one-time promotional credit, (2) we note expiration if PO not issued in 45 days.

Priyom — can you confirm approval path and if we need finance sign-off for the $1,500? If acceptable, please attach a short authorization doc we can send to procurement.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantPath POC timeline / sandbox availability — credit request

Camila / Sergio —

Approved provisionally. I’m authorizing: a 30-day trial extension and a $1,500 one-time sandbox credit applied to the QuantPath trial account. Conditions:
1) Credit expires if no PO or signed SOW within 45 days of issuance.
2) Credit to be logged as promotional (non-refundable).
3) We add a note in HubSpot (HUB-23456) with the authorization id below.

Authorization id: RED-CR-20270322-8342
Approval doc attached. Please send this to their procurement contact so they have something to reference in the PO.

I’ll update Finance for bookkeeping; no further exec approval required at this amount.

—Priyom

Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
